## Feature Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case

Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve? Describe what should happen in the Home app, and in Eve if the reading is one Eve shows, rather than naming an API field.

## Which monitors it applies to

View Plus, View Radon, Wave Mini, or every monitor on the account.

## Proposed Solution

How do you think this could be implemented? See [docs/API.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-myairthings/blob/main/docs/API.md) for the consumer API this plugin calls, and [docs/FEATURES.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-myairthings/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md#out-of-scope) for what is out of scope.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions you've considered.

## Additional Context

Any other context or examples. Do not include a client secret or an access token.
